limitations: Public modules were compiled, decompiled and recompiled, not executed in Roblox.
Source matrix includes four O2 trivial return-nil modules. No accuracy percentage is inferred from successful compilation.
Lexical name counts are not binding-level name accuracy.
Original prototype inventory, oracle comparison universe and structuring invocation counts have different denominators.
Benchmark is warm-cache process wall time including folder I/O on this machine; no cold-cache, peak RSS, allocation census or per-file p95 claim.

Profile counters are instrumented inclusive stage measurements. PAR_LOOP_WALL overlaps F_* counters; S_DEINLINE includes common-tail factoring inside its fixed point. Profiling wall time is not a throughput benchmark.
Runtime probes compare selected outputs/effect traces/error categories; stack locations and all possible inputs are not compared.
Bytecode equality can match different original source texts; library matches are candidates, not recovered comments/types.

naming_loss.method: Lexical absence lower bound, not binding-level name accuracy. Valid debug function names must occur as code identifiers somewhere in the same output to count present; same-name functions can mask losses. Field-to-placeholder is a lexical candidate-site count, not unique bindings.

benchmark.measure: process wall time, warm-cache folder decode+decompile+write; one discarded warmup; interleaved thread counts

local function invoiceTotal(unitPrice: number, quantity: number, discountRate: number)
    local subtotal = unitPrice * quantity
    local discountAmount = subtotal * discountRate
    local totalCost = subtotal - discountAmount
    return totalCost, function() return discountAmount, totalCost end
end
return invoiceTotal

return function(p: number, p2: number, p3: number)
	local v = p * p2
	local v2 = v * p3
	local v3 = v - v2
	return v3, function()
		return v2, v3
	end
end

return function(items, scale)
    local runningTotal = 0
    for index, item in items do
        local weightedScore = item.Score * scale
        runningTotal += weightedScore
        item.LastIndex = index
    end
    local finalScore = runningTotal / #items
    return finalScore
end
probe_cases.output_O2_g1:
return function(list, p)
	local total = 0

	for k, v in list do
		total += v.Score * p
		v.LastIndex = k
	end

	return total / #list
end

probe_cases.source:
local function adjust(value, bias)
    if value < 0 then return bias end
    return value * 2 + bias
end
return function(value)
    local first = adjust(value, 3)
    local second = adjust(value + 1, 3)
    local result = 0
    for i = 1, 4 do result += value * i end
    return first + second + result
end
probe_cases.output_O2_g1:
local function adjust(p, p2)
	if p < 0 then
		return p2
	else
		return p * 2 + p2
	end
end

return function(p)
	local v = p < 0 and 3 or p * 2 + 3
	local v2 = p + 1
	local v3 = v2 < 0 and 3 or v2 * 2 + 3
	local v4 = 0 + p * 1 + p * 2 + p * 3 + p * 4
	return v + v3 + v4
end

probe_cases.source:
return function(condition, primary, fallback)
    local selected = if condition then primary else fallback
    return selected, if selected == nil then "missing" else "present"
end
probe_cases.output_O2_g1:
return function(p, p2, p3)
	if not p then
		p2 = p3
	end

	if p2 == nil then
		return p2, "missing"
	else
		return p2, "present"
	end
end
